data.text: Anders' laptop: board on /dev/cu.usbmodem2101, apps/device/.venv created with pyserial. 25 s live capture with the current firmware: only telemetry (dist_min_distance ~130 mm, imu_tilt stuck at 0.0 with orientation "unknown", temp/humidity). NO button events seen in the stream, so the bridge gets nothing to post until firmware emits {"event_type":"button","key":...,"value":true} and handles office_feedback. atech CLI still not installed.
